title: A Tool to Map AI Programs in the U.S.: A Snapshot from April 2026 and an Analysis of Requirements for AI Majors and Minors
abstract: arXiv:2606.12428v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we locate and analyze existing undergraduate Artificial Intelligence (AI) programs in the United States in Spring 2026, creating a historic record at a time of great change in this area. To create this record, we developed a tool to detect, scrape, and display data from 361 undergraduate AI programs--majors, minors, concentrations, and certificates--at 4-year universities. Our tool, available at https://cicmap.ai, searched 563 institutions to locate these programs, a sample that represents 87% of all undergraduate Computer Science (CS) graduates in the U.S in 2025. This tool allows prospective students, guidance counselors, administrators, and faculty to easily access AI program requirements and is designed to continually update as new programs emerge. translated_title: 美国人工智能项目地图工具：2026年4月快照及AI主修与辅修要求分析
translated_abstract: 在本研究中，我们定位并分析了2026年春季美国现有的本科人工智能（AI）项目，在这一领域发生巨大变化的时期创建了一份历史记录。为创建此记录，我们开发了一个工具，用于检测、抓取并展示来自四年制大学361个本科AI项目（包括主修、辅修、专业方向和证书）的数据。我们的工具可在https://cicmap.ai获取，搜索了563所机构以定位这些项目，该样本代表了2025年美国所有本科计算机科学（CS）毕业生的87%。此工具使潜在学生、指导顾问、管理员和教师能够轻松访问AI项目要求，并设计为随着新项目的出现而持续更新。据我们所知，这项调查代表了迄今为止美国AI项目状态最全面的快照。通过这项工作，我们提供了三项贡献。
tldr: 本研究开发了一个可更新的工具，对2026年美国361个本科AI项目进行了最全面的扫描和展示，为相关群体提供了详细的AI学位要求分析。
en_tdlr: This study develops an updatable tool that provides the most comprehensive scan and display of 361 undergraduate AI programs in the U.S. in 2026, offering detailed analysis of AI degree requirements for stakeholders.
